title: State vocational rehabilitation offices close Nov. 26–27. How Pontotoc job seekers can reach a counselor
excerpt: The Tupelo WIN Job Center in Belden lists Tuesday morning hours for disability employment services. The state also takes requests for information online.

facts.statement: Pontotoc County residents seeking employment help for a disability have a Tuesday morning option before the Thanksgiving holiday. The Tupelo WIN Job Center in Belden normally offers those services from 9 a.m. to noon on Tuesdays. The Mississippi Department of Rehabilitation Services, which provides them, will close all of its offices Thursday and Friday, Nov. 26–27.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County residents seeking employment help for a disability have a Tuesday morning option before the Thanksgiving holiday. The Tupelo WIN Job Center in Belden normally offers those services from 9 a.m. to noon on Tuesdays. The Mississippi Department of Rehabilitation Services, which provides them, will close all of its offices Thursday and Friday, Nov. 26–27.

The state employment agency directs Pontotoc County residents to the Tupelo center, among its nearby locations. The center is at 3200 Adams Farm Road, Suite 2, in Belden. Residents considering a visit on Tuesday, Nov. 24, can call 662-842-4371 to confirm the holiday-week schedule and ask for a counselor appointment. The department asks callers to mention any interpreter or other accommodation they need for the visit.

People who prefer to start from home can use the department’s online Request Services form. It lets residents select their county and request information about work or independent-living support. A staff member follows up to discuss services. For help finding the appropriate office, the department lists 1-800-443-1000.
